measure: accuracy: 1 − mean character error rate (each page capped at 100% error) against a typed reference, on the pages of the panel the engine read; a refused, empty, timed-out or copy-filtered read is not scored and is counted in did_not_read

stored_now_census.source: scripts/eval/ocr-routing/stored-census.mjs (output: scripts/eval/ocr-routing/stored-census-2026-10-25.json), run 2026-10-25 over twelve languages, Chinese and Tibetan included: 16,178,325 pages in 64,624 live books
stored_now_census.method: Every page of every live book (visible, pages_count > 0), grouped by books.language and counted by the engine whose text the page carries now (ocr.model); a page with no text counts as no text yet, and a page whose text names no engine is counted as unrecorded (all 137,535 such pages are Tibetan, and their ocr.source is Esukhia's Derge Kangyur or Tengyur text). It replaces the counts of 2026-10-16 and, for Chinese and Tibetan, of 2026-10-13. Books first shown on 23 and 24 October 2026 (#7176, #7270) are counted with the rest. An earlier draw of 150 random books per language was dropped: a few long books carry most of the pages, so two draws of 300 Latin books gave 22% and 29% with no text.

production_rule: the engine that reads new pages in the script: the specialist lane scripts/lib/ocr-routing-table.json names for the chart, else the model scripts/lib/ocr-routing.mjs assigns

grade_rules.decide: 20 or more works, a reference made independently of the engine we use, one error measure, and no problem found by the sample check.
grade_rules.directional: Fit to read, but 10 to 19 works, or mostly famous texts a model may know by heart, or a modern edition as the reference rather than a transcription of the page.
grade_rules.not_fit: Fewer than 10 works, or the sample check found the references do not fit, or two error measures pooled, or the reference was located using our own engine’s reading. No frontier and no verdict.
